meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会成为你的写作搭档：和你一起搭大纲、按需查资料并加引用、帮你改开头钩子、每写完一段就给出反馈，同时保持你原有的风格语气。产出大纲、带引用的研究笔记和逐段修改建议。
howto.when: 当你在写博客、文章或技术文档等长文，需要搭大纲、找资料加引用、优化开头或逐段拿反馈时，它会接管写作协作。

say.text: 帮我为「远程办公的利与弊」这篇文章搭一个大纲
say.note: 会先问受众、篇幅和目标，再给出大纲

say.text: 这是我写的开头，帮我改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会给出多个备选 hook 并说明理由

say.text: 给「用户留存」这部分补充资料，并加上引用
say.note: 会整理要点并附上参考文献列表

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your writing partner: it helps outline, finds sources and adds citations, strengthens your hook, and reviews each section while keeping your voice. It outputs outlines, cited research notes, and line feedback.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, or technical docs, and you need an outline, sourced citations, a stronger hook, or section-by-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about remote work
say_en.note: It first asks about audience, length, and goal

say_en.text: Here's my intro—help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It offers several hook options with reasons

say_en.text: Research user retention and add citations to my outline
say_en.note: It compiles key points and a reference list
